import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis (1000 Cameras)', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (top-left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    subset = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(subset['megapixels'], subset['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Brand Market Share (top-right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts().head(10)
colors_brand = sns.color_palette('Set3', n_colors=len(brand_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(brand_counts.values, labels=brand_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_brand)
ax2.set_title('Top 10 Camera Brands Market Share', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Average Price by Body Type and 4K Capability (bottom-left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
body_4k_price = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k'])['price_usd'].mean().reset_index()
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
x = np.arange(len(body_types))
width = 0.35

no_4k = []
has_4k = []
for body in body_types:
    no_4k_val = body_4k_price[(body_4k_price['body_type'] == body) & 
                               (body_4k_price['has_video_4k'] == 0)]['price_usd']
    has_4k_val = body_4k_price[(body_4k_price['body_type'] == body) & 
                                (body_4k_price['has_video_4k'] == 1)]['price_usd']
    no_4k.append(no_4k_val.values[0] if len(no_4k_val) > 0 else 0)
    has_4k.append(has_4k_val.values[0] if len(has_4k_val) > 0 else 0)

bars1 = ax3.bar(x - width/2, no_4k, width, label='No 4K', color='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax3.bar(x + width/2, has_4k, width, label='4K Video', color='#4ECDC4', alpha=0.8)

ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Price by Body Type and 4K Capability', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels(body_types, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Price Distribution over Model Years (bottom-right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
years_sorted = sorted(df['model_year'].unique())
price_by_year = [df[df['model_year'] == year]['price_usd'].values for year in years_sorted]

violin_parts = ax4.violinplot(price_by_year, positions=range(len(years_sorted)), 
                               widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
for pc in violin_parts['bodies']:
    pc.set_facecolor('#95E1D3')
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
violin_parts['cmeans'].set_color('#E74C3C')
violin_parts['cmedians'].set_color('#3498DB')

ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Model Year', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(years_sorted)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(years_sorted, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add custom legend for violin plot
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [Line2D([0], [0], color='#E74C3C', lw=2, label='Mean'),
                   Line2D([0], [0], color='#3498DB', lw=2, label='Median')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
